description: A pure CALCULATION node — union several polygons into one outline: coordinates in, coordinates out. Draws nothing on canvas.
instructions:
A value-only node: it takes a polygon as a coordinate LIST and returns the result as a coordinate list. It has no geometry input or output and draws nothing on the canvas — wire val-polygons into a Polygon node when you want it drawn.

INPUT: `polygon` takes the outline as JSON [[x,y],...] metre pairs, local to the anchor. Wire Space Geometry's val-points into valin-polygon.

MERGE takes the WHOLE set: feed it a nested [[[x,y],...],...] list (from Split / Voronoi / BSP ...) and every piece is unioned. A single flat outline is accepted as a one-element set.

OUTPUT: val-polygons publishes the result as a nested [[[x,y],...],...] list, which a Polygon node accepts directly.

Every parameter is wireable (valin-*).
